{{Quote|My Master sends his regards. Do you have any plans to visit him on Polus in the near future?''"<br />"''I'm afraid such a journey would be impossible. The Archives require my constant attention.|"Adollu" and Barra-Rona-Ban|<ref name="RoT" />}}
'''Barra-Rona-Ban''' was a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[990 BBY]], he was tricked by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] to allow her access to the Archives when she went to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Temple under the alias of [[Nalia Adollu]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner of Ban's friend [[Anno Wen-Chii]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Insert this into any of the catalog terminals in the Archives whenever you wish to log in and look something up. Original works may not be removed from the premises, but you are free to copy any materials you find onto this disk for your personal use or collection. I've taken the liberty of preloading your disk with some seminal works that may be of interest to your research.|Barra-Rona-Ban, granting "Adollu" access to the Jedi Archives|<ref name="RoT" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]], Barra-Rona-Ban lived near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]]. Accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Ban befriended a fellow student, the [[Pyn'gani]] [[Anno Wen-Chii]], during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], and the two eventually visited Wen-Chii's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Polus]]. The Cerean ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and was made [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], maintaining offices in one of the Archives' main halls.<ref name="RoT" />

In [[990 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] took up the alias of [[Nalia Adollu]], Wen-Chii's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, to infiltrate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Temple and research information about a disease that had befallen her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Under her alias, she met with Ban, who granted her access to the Archives after exchanging some pleasantries with whom he believed to be the student of his old friend.<ref name="RoT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Master Anno warned me you would say that. He told me you would use any excuse to avoid ever visiting Polus again.''"<br />''"Not everyone takes to the ice and snow with the ardor of the Pyn'gani.|"Adollu" and Barra-Rona-Ban|<ref name="RoT" />}}
A venerable<ref name="RoT" /> and wizened Jedi Master with an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] for detail,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|92|Barra-Rona-Ban}}</ref> Barra-Rona-Ban was made Chief Librarian of the Jedi Archives. His office was covered with [[Book/Legends|journals]], notes, and [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]], and the Cerean spent his [[Time/Legends|time]] focusing his attention on the [[Library/Legends|library]]. Ban was unable to recognize "Adollu" as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] she truly was and instead fell for her lies. While talking to the young woman, Ban was friendly and helped her in getting access to the Archives. Ban disliked [[Water/Legends|snow]] and ice and did not plan to visit Polus again to see his old friend Wen-Chii.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barra-Rona-Ban was created by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', which was published in [[2007]].<ref name="RoT" />
